ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a topographic profile made along the 20° meridian; the vertical axis marks elevation, and the horizontal axis to the right is marked as N (latitude), with latitude ticks such as 0°, 20°, 40°, 60°, and 80°. Point K is marked near about 40°N, located in a low-lying sea area near sea level; the south side is the land profile of northern Africa, and the north side is close to the mountain profile of southern Europe. Then reason: The sea area along the 20° meridian and near about 40°N corresponds to the vicinity of the Mediterranean Sea. A ship going west from place K through the strait refers to passing westward from the Mediterranean Sea through the Strait of Gibraltar. The surface seawater of the Strait of Gibraltar usually flows from the Atlantic Ocean into the Mediterranean Sea, with a flow direction from west to east; the ship sailing west is opposite to the surface current direction, so it is going against the current.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：剖面图沿20°经线展开，K标在约40°N附近的海平面处，位于非洲北部与欧洲南部之间的海域。由此判定K在地中海附近，船向西穿过的是直布罗陀海峡。再用地理常识：直布罗陀海峡表层洋流由大西洋流向地中海，即自西向东。船由K地向西航行，方向与水流相反，所以是逆水而行。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是沿20°经线作的地形剖面，纵轴标注海拔高度，横轴向右标注为N（纬度），有0°、20°、40°、60°、80°等纬度刻度。K点标在约40°N附近，位于海平面附近的低洼海域位置，南侧是非洲北部一带的陆地剖面，北侧接近欧洲南部的山地剖面。
再推理：沿20°经线、约40°N附近的海域对应地中海附近。船由K地向西穿过海峡，指的是从地中海向西通过直布罗陀海峡。直布罗陀海峡表层海水通常由大西洋流入地中海，流向为自西向东；船向西航行与表层水流方向相反，因此是逆水而行。
